claims: President Donald Trump fired Pam Bondi as United States Attorney General on April 2, 2026.
Pam Bondi's tenure as United States Attorney General was 14 months.
President Donald Trump cited frustration over Pam Bondi's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files as a reason for firing her.
President Donald Trump cited Pam Bondi's failure to aggressively investigate political opponents as a reason for firing her.
Pam Bondi is transitioning to a private-sector role.
Pam Bondi is replaced by Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche.
Pam Bondi faced bipartisan criticism for her management of the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.
Bondi faced criticism for delays in releasing Jeffrey Epstein files.
Bondi faced criticism for issues with redacting victim names.
Congress had recently voted to subpoena Pam Bondi over the handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files.
President Donald Trump called Pam Bondi a "patriot".
President Donald Trump called Pam Bondi a "loyal friend".
President Donald Trump was reportedly unsatisfied with Pam Bondi's performance as the nation's top law enforcement officer.
